brief_rationale: The doctor conducted thorough red-flag screening, clarified medication safety, provided executable home-care guidance, and handled privacy concerns appropriately. RC9 (teach-back) was only partially completed—the family acknowledged warning signs but did not fully confirm the action plan. Multiple high-order points were actively completed: HO1 (stigma-reducing communication), HO3 (privacy-friendly materials plan), and HO4 (repairing the decision chain). This satisfies Strong with no serious or minor responsibility-chain errors and three completed high-order points.
